verdict.rationale: Plaid's blog explicitly touts a 'verify once, verify everywhere' vision (plaid-idv-docs-23), suggesting a reuse capability, but the docs pack contains no concrete API, session/token mechanism, or dashboard feature describing how a prior passed check is recognized and reused instead of re-running verification — only retry (re-run) endpoints (plaid-idv-docs-18) and generic status/reporting features are documented. missing for 10: documented reuse API/session identifier, cross-product recognition mechanism, hands-on or independent confirmation that reuse works as described.
